name: DR-45 "Dragoon" Cavalry Blaster
description: The DR-45 "Dragoon" Cavalry Blaster was a type of blaster weapon produced by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc., who used the design of the DD6 blaster pistol to create the DR-45. A convertible carbine long-barreled variation of the DD6, the DR-45 possessed a quick-release clip-on rifle housing and buttstock, which allowed the weapon to be configured from pistol to rifle.
